entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tariq ibn Amr al-Amawi was an Umayyad commander and governor of Medina in 691/92–693. He was a mawla and freedman of Caliph Uthman. He later entered the service of the Umayyad caliph Abd al-Malik and took part in the suppression and execution of the latter's kinsman and claimant to the throne, Amr ibn Sa'id ibn al-As in 689.
